newsitem.title: UK: TIACA to focus on logistics at 1998 int'l forum.
newsitem.headline: TIACA to focus on logistics at 1998 int'l forum.

text.p: The International Air Cargo Association (TIACA) said it has selected "Air cargo 1998: The key to global logistics" as the theme of its next international air cargo forum and exposition.
The biennial event will be held at Le Palais de Congres in Paris from May 3-6, 1998.

In a statement issued in Miami and received in London, TIACA president Christopher Foyle said that the 1996 forum and expo in Dubai attracted more than 3,200 air cargo industry professionals and he forecast that the Paris event would attract 20 to 30 percent more.
TIACA's members include executives from aircraft manufacturers, airlines, airports, suppliers and freight forwarders from all parts of the world, said the statement.
